r.head: Record of the surveyor, as filed.
r.head2: Testimony of the surveyor, in order.
g.Water.1: The river moved. The record did not.
g.Water.3: Something was kept by the river.
g.Work.3: Done by hand. Entered by hand.
g.Strange.3: It was seen. It was not explained.
g.Leaving.3: Somebody left. The chair was kept.
q.talk-weather: It was hot. Then it wasn’t.
q.talk-kin: Your aunt’s my cousin, near enough.
q.rows: Twelve hundred a day with a bar and a bucket.
q.hail: Somebody wrote down every broken tree.
q.bridge-thing: It didn’t chase me. It just looked.
q.tree-lights: They went out when I stopped walking.
q.walked-rows: Every row had the same track down the middle.
q.fence-posts: We kept one. We walk around it.
q.turtle: We sat down in the road and waited.
q.stock-tank: The moon on the water was enough.
q.fog-cranes: Thousands of feet in the water, nobody flying.
q.power: We stood in the yard looking at the house.
q.ruth-foreman: Plant them like you’ll be here when they’re grown.
q.ruth-ledger: Some pages have more in them than the tree.
q.priya-green: The bees came home at noon.
q.priya-rabbits: You can’t count them. They count you.
q.priya-wind: The sand came into the kitchen and lay down.
q.deshawn-mill: It tells you which way. Then it lies.
q.deshawn-above: Somebody flew over once and said the lakes looked like dropped coins.
q.deshawn-well: Sixty years of pennies. Then it didn’t.
q.deshawn-poles: You can see every pole you ever set.
q.frank-door: It’s lit inside. It isn’t for me yet.
q.frank-clay: It looked like old paper. Then it blinked.
q.frank-coyote: At the gate it sat down.
q.frank-unsigned: Write it down. It won’t count.
q.walt-count: To a number that doesn’t exist.
q.walt-aurora: Pink first, then green like grass.
q.walt-sod: Grandmother kept a goat on the roof.
q.tomas-landing: The river doesn’t ask. I just move the post.
q.tomas-ada: She doesn’t fight the river. She asks it.
q.tomas-ice: We walked it anyway, in the dark, listening.
q.tomas-pivot: We named the pipe, not the owl.
q.ada-412: Then they all stood up and I lost count.
q.ada-fours: You count the legs and divide.
q.ada-still: All night. I watched it the whole time.
q.gus-sister: She waved from the middle like it was nothing.
q.gus-looked: Long legs, like sticks that made up their mind.
q.marisol-cousins: Half signed, half didn’t. We still do Christmas.
q.marisol-quilt: Ninety squares. Some are only initials now.
q.marisol-rivers: For a mile they won’t mix.
q.marisol-star: On purpose. Three of us and a ladder.
q.marisol-bluff: The wagon ruts came up out of the grass like they’d been waiting.
q.arne-wire: The whole city came on, and only I saw.
q.arne-bulb: We left it on a year. It got brighter.
q.arne-poles: Look back and there they all are.
q.arne-north: Mother said, remember this. I have.
q.arne-elevator: They swept it out and left the broom. Somebody should keep sweeping.
q.odette-survey: The baby is in four of the stories.
q.odette-copy: My hand will be in the record longer than I will.
q.odette-lamp: Nobody pays for it. It’s in the agreement.
q.odette-bees: The deeds smell like honey in July.
q.imani-water: You get in, and then you’re from somewhere else.
q.lou-valley: My grandfather’s house is under there. On calm days you can see the chimney.
q.lou-lights: Every dusk. Nobody sails. I turn them on anyway.
q.lou-hello: From the dam you can see the tower all the way across. It’s a hello.
q.lou-sundays: He won’t sign. I won’t stop asking. We both come anyway.
q.cal-keeps: A wedding ring, a dog’s collar, a whole canoe. I put them on the shelf by the register.
q.cal-falls: All winter, like it was holding its breath.
q.cal-bison: They came down to drink and the river went quiet.
q.cal-upstream: Empty. Dry inside. It tied itself to my dock.
q.lan-tracks: They don’t come out the other side. I checked.
q.lan-caps: Every year one falls, and nobody hears it.
q.lan-rhino: Barrel-shaped. Short legs. It looked surprised.
q.lan-shelter: Somebody built with the ground they stood on. The wall is mostly bones.
q.maeve-shamrock: Every spring, in the middle of the crossroads. The trucks go around.
q.maeve-postcards: Boston, Butte, Brisbane. All of them say come home.
q.maeve-boat: She brought a cup of dirt from home and planted it under the porch.
q.maeve-hail: We put them in the freezer. Proof.
q.nadia-summit: Three tunnels. In the middle one everybody stops talking.
q.nadia-hat: Probably. I never saw it land.
q.nadia-goods: My great-grandfather sold needles, coffee, and a map that was mostly blank.
q.nadia-blank: He said the blank was where the good stories were.
q.bettina-brush: A rib a summer. They waited twelve million years. They can wait for me.
q.bettina-calf: Even in the ash she was keeping it out of the weather.
q.bettina-sky: The ash came a thousand miles and fell like snow. It never melted.
q.bettina-blinked: Once, in the afternoon. I didn’t tell the others.
q.abuk-train: I race it every morning. Some mornings it lets me win.
q.abuk-cranes: Shift change. All of us stopped and looked up.
q.abuk-break: Nobody shares one. Everybody knows the word for break.
q.abuk-sister: It’s noon where she is. She tells me her weather. I tell her mine.
q.femi-graft: Ruth mailed me a twig in a wet sock. It took.
q.femi-frost: Frost on the blossoms. We stayed up all night talking to the trees.
q.femi-apple: It tastes like the year you were born. Everyone says so.
q.femi-ledger: Every tree planted in the state, by hand. The book stops in 1903.
q.dot-sower: Once, in a thunderstorm. He was facing west in the morning.
q.dot-weather: From the top you can see it coming. I used to warn the senators.
q.dot-dome: They put the lamps on a timer. I still go up and check.
q.dot-gate: Senators, schoolchildren. Everybody tells the elevator the truth.
q.cousin: You’re Odette’s cousin’s kid. I knew it.
q.trail-ruts: Everybody who ever left went by here. You can see where they leaned.
q.lookout: From the top you can see three counties and nobody in them.
q.elevator-sunday: Nobody asked. It’s just that somebody should.
q.duffel-east: Somebody set it down facing the river and kept going without it.
q.boot-fence: One for everybody who walked away and kept walking.
q.kolaches: Apricot, poppy seed, prune. Everybody knew whose were whose.
q.culvert: A stranger who keeps bees shared the culvert.
